objectives.title: Recipient Incident Notification
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding provider notifications to service recipients about significant incidents.
criteria: Provisions requiring recipient notification without undue delay.
Clauses identifying incidents affecting service provision.
Terms specifying the content or channel of the recipient notice.

objectives.title: Threat Mitigation Communication
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding provider communications to service recipients concerning potential threats.
criteria: Provisions requiring communication without undue delay.
Terms regarding disclosure of the threat.

objectives.title: Incident Report Support for Customer Compliance
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions committing the provider to supply the customer with incident information, on a tiered timeline, to support the customer's own regulatory incident-reporting obligations.
criteria: Provisions requiring an initial incident notice to the customer within a short, defined timeframe (e.g., 24 hours) of the provider becoming aware.
Clauses requiring a follow-up notice with a fuller incident assessment (e.g., severity, indicators of compromise) within a longer defined timeframe.
Terms committing the provider to supply information or assistance for the customer's final incident report within a defined period (e.g., one month).
